description:
A FIX Latest dictionary cut to every application message of FIX 4.4, as the classpath resource
        fix-latest-minimal.xml: the whole standard is 173 messages and some 35,000 classes once generated. Generate
        encoders from it with staffix-fix-encoders-generator-maven-plugin, and add staffix-fixt-11 for the FIXT.1.1
        session layer.
